SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
       md.pref_name AS name,
       cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles,
       di.efo_id AS efo_id,
       di.efo_term AS indication_label,
       di.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE LOWER(di.efo_term) = 'schizophrenia'
  AND md.therapeutic_flag = 1;
